THE SECURITY OFFICER NOTIFIED HIS SUPERVISOR AND A NURSE STATIONED IN THE AREA. THE NURSE ASSESSED INMATE CASTILLO AND NOTED THAT HIS PUPILS WERE UNRESPONSIVE, AND HIS PULSE WAS WEAK. EMS WAS CALLED. AT APPROXIMATELY 0358, ADDITIONAL MEDICAL PERSONNEL ARRIVED AT THE AREA AND BEGAN TREATING INMATE CASTILLO. AT THE DETERMINATION OF MEDICAL PERSONNEL, CPR WAS STARTED, AN AED WAS PLACED ON INMATE AND NARCAN WAS ADMINISTERED. CPR WAS CONTINUED UNTIL EMS ARRIVED AT APPROXIMATELY 0408H. INMATE CASTILLO WAS TRANSPORTED TO MIDLAND MEMORIAL HOSPITAL WHERE HIS TREATMENT CONTINUED. HOSPITAL PERSONNEL NOTIFIED JAIL ADMINISTRATION THAT INMATE CASTILLO WAS SUFFERING FROM A DRUG OVERDOSE AND WOULD BE PLACED IN A MEDICAL COMA TO FURTHER EVALUATE HIS CONDITION. ON SEPTEMBER 20, 2023, AT APPROXIMATELY 1448H, INMATE CASTILLO WAS PRONOUNCED DECEASED BY HOSPITAL PERSONNEL.
PENDING RESULTS FROM M.E., THE SUSPECTED CAUSE OF DEATH IS ASPIRIN OVERDOSE.
